Definition: of Hebrew origin (H5374); Neri (i.e. Nerijah), an Israelite:--Neri.
BiblicalUsage: Neri stands in the genealogy of Jesus as the son of Melchi and the father of Shealtiel, a link in the chain Luke draws from Joseph back to David. His name is the whole of his story — one generation passing the promise to the next.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the quiet links hold the chain together: without Neri the line from David to Jesus would have a gap.
